name: Designated Antagonist
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Designated Antagonist (Teamwork)
Source Antihero's Handbook pg. 10
When you antagonize your foes, you can redirect their enmity to your ally.

Prerequisites: AntagonizeUM.

Benefit: When you succeed at a skill check using Antagonize, you can cause the target creature to focus its efforts on a willing ally who also has this feat, as if the ally had been the one to use the ability.
